additions.description: Implements 'favorited' and 'favoritesCount' fields in article responses
additions.reasoning: The specification does not mention any favoriting functionality, but the code includes these fields in article responses with default values.
The specification does not mention a user deletion endpoint, but the code implements one that deletes users by email.
The specification does not mention a standalone tags endpoint, but the code implements one that lists all tags.

additions.description: Implements 'created' and 'updated' fields in article responses (duplicate of createdAt/updatedAt)
additions.reasoning: The specification only mentions createdAt/updatedAt fields, but the code includes these additional duplicate fields.

omissions.description: Does not return empty object {} for deleted articles as specified
omissions.reasoning: The specification states that GET requests to deleted articles should return 200 with an empty object, but the code returns 404.

omissions.description: Does not implement security vulnerability allowing any user to update/delete any article
omissions.reasoning: The specification describes this as a required vulnerability, but the code properly implements authorization checks.

omissions.description: Does not return 500 when attempting to delete a user with articles (FK constraint error)
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires this behavior to test the no CASCADE DELETE configuration, but the code returns a generic 500 error.

omissions.description: Does not return 400 when attempting to follow oneself
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires this error response, but the code silently ignores self-follow attempts.

omissions.description: Does not return 400 when attempting to unfollow oneself
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires this error response, but the code silently ignores self-unfollow attempts.
